desc: Questionnaire question step has a heading (BUG-028, known partial)
steps: Open the questionnaire, click 'Začať'; list headings
expected: The question is exposed as a heading (h1) or the page keeps one h1
actual: headings in main: none; question is a <legend>: "Celkovo, aké boli pre mňa posledné dva t"

desc: Progress bar does not animate under reduced motion (BUG-031)
steps: Set 'Obmedzené' via data-motion=reduce; read the transition of the progress segments
actual: reduce: opacity, color, background-color, border-color, outline-color, text-decoration-color, fill, stroke, box-shadow; full: transform, translate, scale, rotate

desc: Comment field accepts 1 000 characters when emoji are used (BUG-006 residual)
steps: Go to the comment step; type 990 letters followed by 10 emoji
expected: All 1 000 characters accepted (the counter counts characters, so the limit should too)
actual: accepted 995 characters (1000 UTF-16 units, maxlength=1000); counter "995 / 1000"

desc: Kudos text accepts 500 characters when emoji are used (BUG-006 residual)
Kudos: focus after a rejected submit stays on a meaningful element (BUG-016 residual)
steps: Click 'Poslať kudos' with an empty form using the mouse and using Enter from the keyboard
expected: Focus is not dropped to <body> (it should stay on the button or move to the first invalid field)
actual: after mouse click: BODY; after Enter on the button: BODY

desc: Login: focus after a rejected login stays on a meaningful element
steps: Tab to 'Prihlásiť sa' with a wrong password and press Enter

desc: Issue and note forms: error is linked to the invalid field (BUG-029, known open)
steps: Submit the empty issue form and the empty note form; read aria-invalid / aria-describedby of the fields
expected: Invalid fields carry aria-invalid and reference the message
actual: issue title: aria-invalid=null describedby=null; note title: aria-invalid=null; note meetingDate: aria-invalid=null; note text: aria-invalid=null

desc: Required fields are marked as required (BUG-029, known open)
steps: Read required / aria-required on the fields of the new round, action, kudos, issue and note forms
expected: Mandatory fields expose 'required' to assistive technology or show a visible mark
actual: /rounds/new name: required=false; /rounds/new closesAt: required=false; /kudos?tab=send toUserId: required=false; /hr/notes title: required=false; /hr/notes meetingDate: required=false; /hr/notes text: required=false
